_comment: Example of the download catalogue FaunaPulse will fetch over HTTPS. One entry per downloadable file; the app shows kind/name/size/description in a menu, downloads the URL with resume support, verifies sha256, and imports the file exactly like a manual Import.

entries.name: BioCLIP 2 image model (fp16)
entries.description: Turns a crop into an embedding. Needed once; works with every BioCLIP 2 label pack below.

entries.name: Pollinator orders, Europe
entries.description: Flies, bees and wasps, beetles, butterflies and moths with GBIF records in Europe (35,260 species).

entries.name: Flower visitors, 32 families, worldwide
entries.description: Bees, hoverflies and other flies, ladybirds, butterflies, bugs, crab and orb spiders (38,570 species).

entries.name: Mammals, worldwide
entries.description: All 5,999 mammal species BioCLIP knows, for MegaDetector animal boxes.
